text: こっちは　もー　バッチリ　パソコンが　つながったで！

structure.jp: こっちは　もー　バッチリ
structure.en: on my end, it's all perfect already

structure.jp: パソコンが　つながったで！

patterns.name: 〜で (Kansai よ)
patterns.explanation: で at the end of a sentence is the Kansai dialect way of saying よ, telling the listener something with energy. つながったで = 'it's connected, you know!'.
